content: {"reasoning":"The prior CO-22 denial has already been addressed by correcting and resubmitting, and there is no new payer response establishing the corrected claim’s disposition. Authorization is on file, and nothing currently supports another submission, an appeal, or billing the patient or secondary payer without an established primary adjudication. Because no available automated action can properly progress the claim, a specialist should verify the corrected claim’s status and remaining COB issue.","action":"escalate"}
